alt: A 100-point bar split into 35 points the checker recomputes by running the code on hidden test cases, 42 points (12 + 30) read from the submission's own results file and never verified, and 23 points from other checks (code text 3, behaviour monitor 8, report keywords 12). A box explains that a sound fix would need the checker to recompute the 42 points itself, and a note mentions a second, fixed problem: one of two allowed method forms was penalised (88.92 against 42.86 out of 100 for the same strong work).
caption: 42 of the 100 points come from numbers the submission reports about its own work, and the checker never verifies them, so the task was removed. The agent implements the D-ABIC gravity inversion method. The checker recomputes only 35 points, by running the code on hidden test cases; two parts, worth 12 and 30 points, are scored from the submission's own results file as written. A sound fix would need the checker to recompute those 42 points from hidden data itself. A second problem was fixed but did not save the task: one of two allowed, equivalent method forms carried a hidden penalty (88.92 against 42.86 out of 100 for the same strong work at C = 26, computed from the checker's own rule; the gap grows with C).
